name: Giant Stump
description: The stump of an ancient tree towers above the young forest like a round tower.

scenes.name: Root Arches
scenes.description: Thick roots form passages large enough for an adult animal to fit through comfortably.

scenes.name: Tree Ring Platform
scenes.description: Hundreds of rings and several dark marks of unknown origin are visible on the cut surface.

scenes.name: Fern Balcony
scenes.description: A whole garden of ferns and red woodland flowers has grown on a ledge of the stump.
